name: Paradise Valley (United States)
description: Horizontal bicolour of navy blue and green, charged at the centre with the white town seal showing Camelback Mountain and the words INCORPORATED MAY 1961.
history: Paradise Valley is an affluent suburb of Phoenix, Arizona. Flags of the World records that the flag was designed in 2003 by councilwoman Virginia Simpson to be flown at the Arizona League of Cities and Towns conference.
